scripts.extension:build: sh -c 'if command -v pg_config >/dev/null 2>&1; then make -C extension clean && make -C extension && make -C extension install; else echo "pg_config not found; skipping local extension build (Docker build still compiles and installs extension)."; fi'
scripts.build:all: npm run extension:build && npm run docker:build
scripts.build:all:alpine: npm run extension:build && npm run docker:build:alpine
